Cable, three-conductor cable  |  Unit: kg

This product represents a 1 meter of a 1 kV low voltage cable with copper wire sheath, type GKN (Ceander / waveconal cable) with a meter-weight of 1.04 kg/m. It represents a low-voltage power cable, used for distribution networks and in industry. It includes all materials necessary to construct it and energy consumption during manufacturing.

Cable, unspecified  |  Unit: m

This product represents an unspecified cable. The cable consists of 66% copper and 34% plastics. It includes all materials necessary to construct it and energy consumption during manufacturing.

Setup the emission factor (EF) of this material for PCF calculations.


EFs should represent the embedded emissions of a material, including your supplier’s scope 1, scope 2 and upstream scope 3 emissions.


You can search out databased for a reference value that matches your material. Or to use an alternative source (e.g. Market-based EF from your supplier); selet ‘Provide a custom EF’.

verified_user

All data gathered and calculated in M2030 are private to your organization by default.


Material data are only used to calculate PCFs. This data remain private to your organization if you decide to share PCFs with customers.

To ensure all required data are captured, use this template to gather and import your data:

M2030_Material_import_template.xlsx


Required fields:

• Material name

• Material ID

• Source geography

• Emission factor (EF) CO2e value

• EF emission unit (Unit representing the amount of emissions in the EF)

• EF produced unit (Unit representing the amount of emission producing material in the EF)

• Weight (kg) per EF produced unit

• Is EF from a primary or secondary source?
